scraper_notes: Preserve exact URL casing from source HTML — Fairfax uses both Assets/documents/ and Assets/Documents/ depending on section, and it is not consistently predictable per phase: confirmed 2026-07-07 that a single budget committee meeting folder can contain both casings side by side (e.g. mar-10/2026_March_10_BudgetComm_CIP.pdf under Assets/documents/ next to mar-10/Agenda.pdf under Assets/Documents/).
Board PDFs live under two distinct roots — both must be watched.
Committee PDFs under boardofsupervisors are nested within individual meeting-date pages. Discovery requires a multi-hop crawl.

Budget committee meeting PDFs live under the budget subdomain at Assets/{documents,Documents}/budget%20committee%20meeting/. Match these patterns BEFORE the broader Assets/documents/ pattern to avoid misclassification as budget_pdf.

The board-of-supervisors meeting-schedule root is year-stamped (…/boardofsupervisors/2026-board-meetings) — confirmed live 2026-07-07. It will need updating to …/2027-board-meetings etc. as the county rolls the page over each year; the old board-meeting-information URL from 2026-06-19 now 404s.

sources.discovery_note: Committee PDFs are nested within individual committee meeting-date pages (Legislative, Budget Policy, Land Use Policy, Transportation, Environmental, etc.), separate from the full-board meeting-date pages. The crawler must follow meeting schedule links into those pages before extracting PDF links.

sources.label: Budget Committee Meeting Records (budget domain)
sources.discovery_note: Budget committee meeting materials are linked from per-meeting sub-pages (e.g. board-supervisors-budget-committee-meeting-march-10-2026), not directly from the listing page. The listing page covers 15+ years of history (89 meeting sub-pages back to 2008 as of 2026-07-08) and repeats the county site's full global nav on every page load; discovery_link_prefix keeps the depth-2 crawl inside /budget/ instead of following that nav out to unrelated county pages (confirmed live 2026-07-08: 265 of 381 links on the listing page are outside /budget/), which was tripping the edge function's WORKER_RESOURCE_LIMIT. That alone wasn't enough — scanning all 89 archived meetings' documents every run (a HEAD+GET per document, rate-limited) still pushed a single invocation past the platform's 150s idle timeout, so discovery_follow_min_year additionally limits which meeting sub-pages get crawled to the last 3 years. Trade-off: meetings before 2024 are not (re-)discovered by this recurring job — a one-time manual backfill (temporarily raising discovery_depth's reach via a lower min year, or a one-off run with the field removed) would be needed to ingest the pre-2024 archive; as of 2026-07-08 zero budget_committee_meeting documents have ever been ingested, so that backfill is still outstanding.
sources.casing_note: Confirmed 2026-07-07: the same meeting folder mixes both casings (CIP presentation under lowercase documents/, Agenda.pdf under uppercase Documents/) — both patterns are required.
